list.title: Apps
list.hint: Apps act as their own bot account on the repositories where they are installed, with the permissions you choose.
list.notAllowed: The instance policy does not let you register Apps here.
visibility.title: Where can this App be installed?
visibility.privateHint: Private: only the owner of the App can install it.
visibility.publicHint: Public: anyone on this instance can install it.
form.name: App name
form.slugHint: Used in URLs and for the bot account, which will be {bot}. Left empty, it is derived from the name. It cannot change later.
form.descriptionHint: Shown to people when they install the App.
form.homepageHint: The full URL of the App's website (http or https).
form.logoHint: Optional https URL of a square image. Without it the first letter of the name is shown.
form.userAuthHint: Callback URLs for user-to-server tokens through the OAuth web flow. Up to 10.
form.setupHint: Optional. After an installation the browser goes here with installation_id and setup_action.
webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.hint: Events of the installations are delivered to this URL.
webhook.secretHint: Optional. Deliveries are signed with X-Hub-Signature-256.
webhook.secretKeep: A secret is set. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
perm.title: Permissions
perm.hint: What the App can do on the accounts and repositories where it is installed.
perm.editHint: Installations keep their current permissions until their owners accept the new ones.
perm.alwaysRead: Always read: names, visibility and basic data
perm.contents.hint: Files, branches, tags, commits and releases
perm.metadata.hint: Names, visibility and basic data of the repositories
perm.issues.hint: Open, comment, label and close issues
perm.pull_requests.hint: Open, comment, review and merge pull requests
perm.administration.hint: Repository settings, collaborators and branch protection
perm.email_addresses.hint: The email addresses of the account
events.title: Subscribe to events
events.hint: Only the events covered by the permissions above can be picked.
pending.title: New permissions requested
pending.hint: The App asks for more than this installation granted. It keeps the old permissions until you accept.
repos.title: Repository access
repos.hint: Which repositories of the account the App can see.
new.title: Register a new App
new.hint: The App acts as its own bot account on the repositories where it is installed.
new.done: App registered. Generate a private key to authenticate as the App.
edit.title: App settings
deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.noHook: The App has no webhook URL; earlier deliveries are still listed.
keys.title: Private keys
keys.hint: The App signs a JWT with a private key to get installation tokens. Only the public key is kept.
keys.full: An App can have at most {max} private keys. Revoke one to generate another.
keys.once: Store this private key now: the server does not keep it and cannot show it again.
keys.empty: No private keys yet. The App needs one to authenticate.
keys.deleteHint: JWTs signed with the key {fingerprint} stop working right away.
secrets.title: Client secrets
secrets.hint: Used with the client ID to get user-to-server tokens through the OAuth web flow.
secrets.full: An App can have at most {max} client secrets. Delete one to generate another.
secrets.once: Copy the client secret now: it will not be shown again.
secrets.deleteHint: The secret ending in {hint} stops working right away.
installations.title: Installations
installations.hint: Accounts and organizations where this App is installed.
installations.empty: The App is not installed anywhere yet
installed.title: Installed Apps
installed.hint: Apps installed on this account, with the repositories they can reach.
installed.suspendHint: The App keeps its configuration but cannot act or receive events until you unsuspend it.
installed.unsuspendHint: The App can act and receive events again.
installed.uninstallHint: The App loses access to this account and its tokens stop working.
danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteHint: Removes the App with its installations, keys and tokens. The bot account stays, so the slug cannot be registered again.
install.title: Install {app}
install.account: Where do you want to install it?
install.noTargets: There is no account you can install this App on.
